title: Rabbi Chanilai bar Chanilai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Avodah Zarah 18b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.18b.15) he said, “Anyone who mocks brings destruction upon the world.” Hyman reports another reading, R' Tanchum bar Chanilai, also found in Dikdukei Soferim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli gives Rabbi Chanilai bar Chanilai. The parallel in [Yalkut Shimoni on Isaiah](https://www.sefaria.org/Yalkut_Shimoni_on_Nach.436.14) gives Rabbi Tanchum bar Chanilai.
[Heilprin’s Tanchum entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3576&lang=en) records that difference. Hyman also reports the Tanchum reading from Dikdukei Soferim.
